decision: Make the DEV qualification workflow portable to the macOS arm64 hosted runner by resolving Git and npm through the reviewed PATH and binding offline dependency preparation to the checkout-local npm cache.
implemented_capabilities: PATH-portable Git and npm invocation across live repository checks and package-install tests
checkout-local npm cache selection for exact offline qualification support preparation
disposable build-local npm cache isolation for artifact packing
regression enforcement against host-specific Homebrew Git and npm paths in executable source and tests
architectural_invariants: the immutable extraction provenance records retain their historical toolchain paths
qualification still fails closed on missing dependencies, unexpected skips, or incomplete evidence
runner portability does not advance maturity or release authority
